question: The Mughals were descendants of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Genghis Khan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Mughals:**

 
 
• The Mughals were descendants of two great lineages of rulers.
 
• From their mother’s side, they were descendants of Genghis Khan (died 1227), the Mongol ruler who ruled over parts of China and Central Asia.
 
• From their father’s side, they were the successors of Timur (who died in 1404), the ruler of Iran, Iraq and modern-day Turkey.
 
• However, the Mughals did not like to be called Mughal or Mongol.
 
• This was because Genghis Khan’s memory was associated with the massacre of innumerable people.
 
• It was also linked with the Uzbeks, their Mongol competitors.
 
• On the other hand, the Mughals were proud of their Timurid ancestry, not least of all because their great ancestor had captured Delhi in 1398.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ghiyasuddin Balban (1266-1287)

 
 
• He was also known as Ulugh khan.
 
• He was one of the main architects of the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• According to him, the Sultan was God’s shadow on earth (Zil-i-Ilahi) and recipient of divine grace (Nibyabat-i-Khudai).
 
• He introduced the Persian festival Nawrouz.
 
• Called himself Nasir-amir-ul-momin (Caliph’s right-hand man).
 
• He separated Diwan-i-wizarat (Finance Department) from the Diwan-i-Arz (Military Department).
 
• Ghiyasuddin Balban introduced rigorous court discipline and new customs such as Sijada (prostration) and Paibos (kissing the Sultan’s feet).
